# Get Contents of Folder

iOS 15 +

## Notes

Get's the content of the provided folder.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getFolderContents(folder: <#Variable#>, recursive: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getFolderContents(folder: ShortcutInput, recursive: true)
~~~~
